chunks: "Whoever recites in the Witr prayer the two protective chapters and 'Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad,' it will be said to him: 'Rejoice, O servant of Allah, for Allah has accepted your Witr.'"

key_terms.الْوَتْرِ: the Witr prayer performed in the night prayer
key_terms.بِالْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ: with the two chapters of seeking refuge, Surat al-Falaq and Surat al-Nas
key_terms.قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ: Surat al-Ikhlas, recited in the prayer

ai.seo_question: What is the merit of reciting al-Mu'awwidhatayn and Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad in Witr prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages reciting al-Mu'awwidhatayn and Surat al-Ikhlas in the Witr prayer. It highlights the virtue of these recitations and conveys glad tidings that such Witr is accepted by Allah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
"Whoever recites in the Witr prayer the two protective chapters (Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas) and 'Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad' (Surah Al-Ikhlas), it will be said to him,
'Rejoice, O’ servant of Allah (swt), for Allah (swt) has accepted your Witr.'"
